    requires forall i :: 0 <= i < |arr| ==> arr[i] >= 0
    ensures forall i, j :: 0 <= i < |result| && 0 <= j < |result| && result[i] < result[j] ==>

            (countOnes(result[i]) == countOnes(result[j]) && result[i] < result[j]))
    ensures |result| == |arr|
    
    // Helper method to count the number of 1s in the binary representation of an integer
    method countOnes(x: int) returns (count: int)
        requires x >= 0
        ensures count >= 0
        ensures count == (if x == 0 then 0 else countOnes(x / 2) + (x % 2))
```
